## ⚡ Quick Start: 1-Line Sovereign CLI

Install the complete offline workstation CLI in one terminal command:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://experimentlab.in/install.sh | bash
```

Launch an interactive STEM derivation session:
```bash
vigyan
```

Run one-shot symbolic evaluations:
```bash
vigyan "integrate x**2 * exp(-x) from 0 to inf"
```

Clean, zero-trace uninstaller:
```bash
curl -fsSL https://experimentlab.in/uninstall.sh | bash
```

---

## 🔬 Core Architecture

- **100% Air-Gapped Local Execution**: Runs entirely in local memory on standard consumer laptops ($4\text{ GB}$ to $16\text{ GB}$ RAM) using sub-2GB GGUF models (`Vigyan-3B Quad-Master`).
- **Deterministic Math Truth**: Integrates Python's native SymPy Computer Algebra System (CAS) with AST parsing to eliminate neural hallucinations on proofs, integrals, and physics formulas.
- **PolyForm Noncommercial Licensing**: Free forever for individual academic research, students, doctors, and engineers. Enterprise deployments operate under custom fixed-scope on-premise agreements.
